## Week 40 Journal

1. Learning [Strudel](https://strudel.cc), a scripting language based on JavaScript to create music beats. I wrote 1st
   beat in [Strudel][arv-mix-1]. As I am learning this, I can hear the beats behind the songs more clearly but I
   couldn't able to recreate it in Strudel. :(
   - [Lucy Cheesman - Learn how to make music through live coding](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QRJ0xrjLj6A)
   - [Create Music with Code Using Strudel](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MLE5qncxq0k)
   - [From Scratch STRUDEL TUTORIAL](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SsUbCq7yoxo)
   - [WORKSHOP // Coding Music With Strudel // Dan Gorelick and Viola He](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oqyAJ4WeKoU)
   - [STRUDEL FOR BEGINNERS - Glossing](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m7Rp46AU8dw)
2. I came to know that there is `and` pattern/statement as well in Python just like `or` pattern. :shocking:
3. Exploring Prometheus and Grafana to add monitoring in EC2 and deployed apps.
4. **MUSIC:** Have You Ever Seen The Rain, Hotel California, Every Breath You Take.
5. Wrote second beat [ARV Mix 2][arv-mix-2].
6. **Caption from Instagram:** The sun had its "kaash," the moon knew its "khair".
7. Poems:

   ```text
   Itnezar hai kab tumse milunga,
   Gin raha hun bas 12 (week) he bache hain,
   Mushkil se main 3 (week) he de paunga,
   Rakhta hun khyalon me tumhe har waqt,
   Bas ab 30 (day) he hain ye bhi guzar jayenge,
   Jaise guzre pichhle 30 (week).

   ---
   Maine bahut kam zindagi jee hai, ab use ye kitabein puri kar rahin hain.
   Maine bahut kam logon se baatein ki hai, ab use ye kitabein puri kar rahin hain.
   Maine bhaut kam ghuma hai, ab use ye kitabein puri kar rahin hain.
   Maine bahut kam roya hai, ab mujhe ye kitabien rula rahin hai.

   ---
   Unke saath samay bitana, gaane sunna, unse baatien karte-karte aankhon se paani aana aur phir unke he saath akele soo jana.
   -- Ab khayal aata hai ki wo koi aur nahi main aur meri tanhai thi.
   Ab maine samjha hai ki woo koi aur nahi main aur meri tanhai thi.
   ```

8. Lost in Strudel due to that, I am not able to read **"Ret Ki Machhali"** and not able to write more poems above are
   written on Monday and Tuesday.
9. I want to write **Autobiography**, although this Journal is already one but it's not from start. It's not full. It's
   just a slice of my life, a precisely carved slice to share. Although, I want to write it by hand but I also want to
   maintain a digital copy which I can share. I can do one thing that I can first write each day in diary then at the
   end of the week rewrote in digital with corrections.

3. Thoughts:

   ```text
   Aapke saath kabhi aisa hua ki,
   Kisi jagah aapne ek gana suna ho,
   Aur phir jab aap woo ganna kahin aur sunnte ho tab aapko uss jagah ki yaad dilati hai.

   ---
   My belief is that i can't waste my life's 3 hours on any movie, that's why I tend to appreciate movie explanations and video essays and if I like it I'll watch it.
   On the other hand, i waste my life's 3 hours of precious time scrolling socials and ---- websites. Here's my hypocrisy comes amd I feel defeated and shamful. I can't tell anyone about it but I know it and feel guilty about it.

   ---
   What type of secret i have buried?
   I can't even share it because there's no one in range.
   I can't share it because of dilemma of having the wrong decryption key.
   Some got it some and some got the d-key of my past thoughts which lead them to something whole different.

   ---
   Ye panne aur mics to thik hain,
   Lekin lagta hai ki ye bhi thak gaye hain,
   Agar kuch aisa mil jaye jo mere batao ko,
   Sanjog ke na rakh le, ya bas sunn ke saant na rahe,
   Woo unhe sunne, samjhe, aur phir mujhe woo apne baaton ko bataye.
   ```
